abstract: Connect Claude Code to self-hosted and gateway models over the Anthropic Messages API. Covers install and updates, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper without printing secrets, per-engine setup for vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, llama-swap and LiteLLM, model slot mapping and discovery, context and output limits, compatibility switches for non-Anthropic backends (betas, thinking, tools, streaming), troubleshooting, and an endpoint probe script.
